projects.title: Multi-Agent Event Planning Assistant
projects.summary: A multi-agent event planner built with CrewAI and Google Gemini. An Event Manager agent delegates to four specialists (venue, catering, budget and schedule). The agents work through search tools, and plain Python code re-checks the final plan. It comes with a FastAPI backend and a responsive web interface with light and dark modes.
projects.lead: An AI planning team that finds the venue and menu, prices the whole event, builds the day's agenda, and double-checks every detail before calling the plan ready.

cover.label: Light theme
cover.alt: Multi-agent Event Planner web app with the event details form, a live cost estimate and the planning team of five agents

cover.label: Dark theme
cover.alt: The same Event Planner web app in the dark theme

blocks.text: Planning even a one-day event means matching a venue, meals, equipment, a budget and a timetable. This project automates that with a team of AI agents.
You enter the city, date, number of guests, budget, hours, vegetarian meals and equipment needs. An Event Manager agent then delegates the work to four specialist agents:

items.title: Venue Specialist
items.text: Finds venues with enough capacity, the right facilities and availability on that date.

items.title: Catering Specialist
items.text: Picks standard and vegetarian meal packages that meet their minimum order sizes.

items.title: Budget Analyst
items.text: Prices the venue, meals and equipment rentals, adds a 10% contingency, and checks the total against the budget.

items.title: Schedule Planner
items.text: Builds a timed agenda that fits inside the event window with no overlaps.

items.caption: Event form, live estimate and the planning team
items.alt: Event Planner web app with the event details form, a live cost estimate bar and the five agents of the planning team

blocks.text: Quick check finds the lowest-cost plan instantly, with no AI. Create plan runs the full agent team. Build it yourself lets you pick your own venue and menus and see the quote and checks update live.

items.caption: Plan result with quote and checks
items.alt: A finished plan with an itemized quote showing subtotal, 10% contingency, total and money left over, next to a summary of how the plan was checked

items.caption: Plan result in dark mode
items.alt: The same finished plan shown in the dark theme

items.caption: Build it yourself
items.alt: Build it yourself mode with venue and menu options to pick from and an editable agenda that checks for overlaps

sections.title: Guardrails
sections.sub: The AI does not approve its own work

blocks.text: The key design idea is that the AI is not trusted to approve its own work. The important rules are enforced in code:

items.text: All money is calculated with exact decimal arithmetic and ROUND_HALF_UP rounding.
The search tools reject any city or date that differs from the request, so an agent cannot invent one.
The manager gets at most three budget revisions.
A plan is only labelled "feasible" after Python re-validates the final selection.
A plan is only called "impossible" if an exhaustive search of every venue and menu combination confirms it.
Multi-agent team with a manager that delegates to specialists (CrewAI hierarchical process)
Instant "Quick check" mode that finds the lowest-cost plan with no AI
"Create plan" mode that runs the full agent team
"Build it yourself" mode to pick your own venue and menus and see the quote and checks update live
Itemized quote with subtotal, 10% contingency, total and money left over
Editable agenda with validation of times, the event window and overlaps
Live estimate bar showing the lowest possible cost against your budget
Light and dark themes, and print or save as PDF
Six built-in test scenarios, including impossible ones (venue too small, no availability, too much equipment requested)
Every run is logged with every tool call, delegation and the final report, as evidence of how the plan was reached

items.label: AI agents
items.value: CrewAI (hierarchical process, manager agent, custom tools)

items.label: Backend and API
items.value: FastAPI with interactive API docs, served by Uvicorn

items.label: Frontend
items.value: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a single page, with no framework

items.label: Data
items.value: CSV and JSON datasets (12 venues, 9 catering packages, 9 equipment records)

items.label: Tooling
items.value: uv for dependency management, python-dotenv for configuration

items.text: Designing agentic AI systems with delegation, tools and guardrails
Combining LLM reasoning with deterministic validation, so results can be verified
Building an API-first backend with background jobs and live progress polling
Writing a clean, accessible interface without a front-end framework
Auditability: structured logs that prove what each agent did

projects.title: Event Planner
projects.summary: A reservation platform with three views for Admin, Businessman and Client roles. Clients browse venues, salons, catering and photographers, and book based on availability.
projects.lead: A reservation platform with three views: Admin, Vendor and Client. Businesses are listed in four categories: venue, salon, catering and photography. Clients browse them and book based on availability.

cover.label: Event Planner, venues
cover.alt: Event Planner client page showing venue cards with price per plate and rating

blocks.text: Every user first creates an account for their role (Vendor or Client). The Admin can only log in.

When a vendor adds business details in any category and clicks Upload, a request goes to the Admin to verify the business. When the Admin accepts the request, the data becomes available on the Client site. If the Admin discards it, clients do not see it.

sections.title: Vendor site
sections.sub: Create, my uploads, reservation requests, upcoming events

items.title: Create
items.text: The vendor adds business details in any category and clicks Upload. The request goes to the Admin to verify the business.

items.title: My uploads
items.text: The vendor sees all their uploads and can edit or delete them.

items.title: Reservation requests
items.text: The vendor sees reservation requests and accepts or discards them according to available dates.

items.title: Upcoming events
items.text: The vendor sees the upcoming events from the requests they accepted.

items.title: Categories
items.text: The client sees all venues, salons, catering and photographers, and reserves according to their choice.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: The client sees whether the vendor accepted or discarded their reservation request.

items.title: My booking
items.text: The client sees the events they booked.

projects.title: ChitChat
projects.summary: A real-time chat app with authenticated users and unread-message tracking, powered by SignalR.
projects.lead: A real-time chat app with authenticated users and unread-message tracking, powered by SignalR. Every registered user is listed, so you can search for anyone and start a chat.

cover.label: ChitChat, conversation
cover.alt: ChitChat conversation between two users, with an online users list on the left

blocks.text: When a user first enters the website, they create an account. If they already have an account, they just log in.
All users of the website are listed, so a user can chat with anyone and search for any user.
